highlights: Open-source AI models are pushing frontiers in agentic and multimodal capabilities, with NVIDIA releasing an open 30B MoE for agent execution and Meta introducing a 30B agentic model deployable on consumer GPUs.
Real-time, multimodal AI agents are advancing rapidly, exemplified by ByteDance's omni-modal LLM for continuous interaction and Google's AMIE demonstrating real-time clinical video consultations.
Tools for LLM observability, efficient training, and robust evaluation are maturing, crucial for developers to deploy reliable and cost-effective AI systems in production environments.

agents.title: Google's AMIE Medical AI System Demonstrates Real-Time Video Consultations
agents.summary: Google's AMIE, a research medical AI system, achieved a significant milestone by demonstrating real-time clinical video consultation capabilities in a simulated setting, showcasing advanced diagnostic and interactive potential for healthcare AI.

agents.title: LLM Agents Master Negotiation with Private Information in Supply Chains
agents.summary: New research benchmarks LLM agents in complex supply chain negotiations with private information, revealing high value creation and predictable surplus division, while also establishing an equilibrium-referenced audit for their reliability and economic impact in autonomous procurement.

agents.title: CMU-Drive Introduces Benchmark and V2V-VLA Model for Cooperative Autonomous Driving
agents.summary: CMU-Drive launches a closed-loop, end-to-end benchmark for cooperative multi-agent autonomous driving and proposes V2V-VLA models to integrate cooperative perception, reasoning, and planning, establishing a new foundation for future research in multi-agent CAVs.

models.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30B Open MoE for Agent Execution
models.summary: NVIDIA AI unveils Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, an open 30B MoE with 3B active parameters, specifically targeting the agent execution layer, complemented by the NeMo Switchyard Model Router to optimize model selection at each step.

models.title: Meta AI Launches Muse Glimmer: A 30B Open-Weights Agentic Model for Consumer GPUs
models.summary: Meta AI releases Muse Glimmer, a 30B open-weights agentic model designed to run efficiently on a single consumer GPU (24 GB VRAM), delivering 3.1x faster decoding with DFlash speculation and available under Apache 2.0.

models.title: ByteDance Seed Introduces SeedRealtime: A Native Audio-Visual Full-Duplex LLM
models.summary: ByteDance's Seed team introduces SeedRealtime, a groundbreaking native audio-visual full-duplex LLM that unifies audio, video, and text in a single architecture, enabling real-time, continuous multimodal interaction toward omni-modal AI.

tools.title: MarkTechPost Compares Top LLM Observability and Evaluation Platforms of 2026
tools.summary: A verified 2026 comparison reviews leading LLM observability and evaluation platforms like Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust, and Arize, detailing tracing depth, evaluation capabilities, production monitoring, and pricing for developers building robust LLM applications.

tools.title: Data-Centric Parallel (DCP) Accelerates Training for Variable Long Sequences
tools.summary: Data-Centric Parallel (DCP) is introduced as a new method to dynamically adjust runtime settings based on batch sequence length, achieving up to 2.88x speedup on H200 GPUs and simplifying the training of deep learning models on variable long sequences with minimal code changes.

tools.title: TeXFix-Bench: A Multi-Format Benchmark for LLM-Based Document Source Repair
tools.summary: TeXFix-Bench is released as an empirically grounded, multi-format benchmark for evaluating LLM-based document source repair across LaTeX, Typst, and Markdown, based on a mined fault taxonomy and highlighting that compile success alone overstates repair quality.

companies.title: OpenAI Daybreak Models Now Available on AWS for Enterprise Cybersecurity
companies.summary: OpenAI's Daybreak cybersecurity capabilities, including GPT-5.6-Cyber for authorized vulnerability research, are now available through Amazon Bedrock, expanding access to frontier cyber models for enterprise security workflows via AWS.

companies.title: OpenAI Report Reveals How Enterprises Adopt Agentic AI for Execution
companies.summary: OpenAI research provides insights into how enterprises are transitioning from AI assistance to execution, actively adopting agentic AI with ChatGPT and Codex to drive operational transformation, with frontier firms leading AI adoption.

companies.title: OpenAI Improves GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT and Expands Luna Access for Free Users
companies.summary: ChatGPT introduces an improved GPT-5.6 Sol with enhanced accuracy and consistency for paid users, alongside expanded access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users, offering unlimited everyday chats and broadening advanced AI capabilities to a wider audience.

learning.title: Tutorial: Building a Quantitative Trading Strategy with OctoBot and Backtesting
learning.summary: A comprehensive tutorial guides users through building and validating a complete quantitative trading strategy using OctoBot and OctoBot-Script, covering rule-based strategy configuration, walk-forward backtesting, parameter optimization, and interactive analysis.

learning.title: Guide: Implementing a Multimodal Video and Audio Generation Pipeline with ComfyUI APIs
learning.summary: This guide demonstrates how to implement a complete, programmable MiniMax-H3 multimodal generation pipeline leveraging ComfyUI as a headless backend, detailing setup for automated inference, hardware profiling, dynamic graph construction, and joint video-audio decoding.

learning.title: Google and Kaggle Host 353,000-Person AI Agents Intensive Course
learning.summary: Google and Kaggle collaborated to host a massive 'AI Agents Intensive' no-cost coding course, bringing together 353,000 learners to build and deploy the next generation of AI agents, providing a significant global upskilling opportunity.
